d: Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman promised a sci-fi revolution: The Line at NEOM. A 170-kilometer-long mirrored city in the desert designed to house 9 million people with zero emissions, flying taxis, and an artificial moon. Fast forward to today, and the dream is stalling. Over $50 billion of Saudi public funds have vanished into the sand, construction has ground to a near-halt, and internal targets have collapsed.
